subject: lan
title: (R)LANG------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 402 (JR-24). LAN (the title writes LANG) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: ROJ-DY, C-CONT (composite continuance) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From ROJ-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: AF-NT (affinity nature). From AF-NT: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From C-CONT: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: INFO-TRNS (information transference). From SOC-RT-DY: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: STY (style).
